source: MITRE ATT&CK + public ransomware playbook reporting

playbooks.name: Conti
playbooks.description: Conti ransomware affiliate playbook: spearphish entry, hands-on-keyboard PowerShell, LSASS credential dumping, SMB/PsExec lateral movement, and mass encryption.

playbooks.name: LockBit
playbooks.description: LockBit 3.0 affiliate playbook: initial access via exploited public-facing app or stolen RDP credentials, Cobalt Strike beaconing, credential theft, lateral spread, and double-extortion encryption.

playbooks.name: BlackCat
playbooks.description: BlackCat/ALPHV playbook: identity-driven access (compromised VPN/RDP credentials), privileged credential theft, deployment via PsExec/SMB, and cross-platform Rust encryption with exfiltration.

playbooks.name: Akira
playbooks.description: Akira ransomware playbook: VPN credential compromise (often lacking MFA), hands-on-keyboard via Cisco SSH/AnyConnect, credential theft with LSASS, lateral SMB/RDP, and encryption with data exfiltration.
